rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person's skill in speaking fluently and persuasively.

example.english: Their eloquence quickly won everyone over.
example.traditional: 佢口才好好，幾句就講到大家都信服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hau2 coi4 hou2 hou2 gei2 geoi3 zau6 gong2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 seon3 fuk6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on how convincing the speech or writing is, rather than on its artistry.

example.english: The eloquence of their speech got everyone to support the plan.
example.traditional: 佢份演講稿嘅說服力好強，搞到大家都支持個計劃。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fan6 jin2 gong2 gou2 ge3 seoi3 fuk6 lik6 hou2 koeng4 gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 ci4 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this for eloquence shown through stylish, artistic writing or literary expression.

example.english: This writer's eloquence makes the article very moving.
example.traditional: 呢位作家嘅文章文采飛揚，讀落好有感染力。
example.jyutping: nei1 wai6 zok3 gaa1 ge3 man4 zoeng1 man4 coi2 fei1 joeng4 duk6 lok6 hou2 jau5 gam2 jim5 lik6
